roads.name: Highway 542
words: Sweeping and steady: 13 curves in 5.2 miles.
From 745 to 818 ft, with 303 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 80 km/h limit its corners still ask for about 0.47 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.

roads.name: Highway 6
words: An easygoing road: 16 curves in 8.2 miles, with room to breathe between them.
From 580 to 730 ft, with 561 ft of up and down along the way.
14 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
